title: Square and multiply: 3 to the power 13

frames.note: 13 in binary is 1101 (read right to left here: bit 0 first). So 3^13 = 3^8 · 3^4 · 3^1
Bit 0 is 1: multiply the result by 3^1 = 3, giving 3
Bit 1 is 0: skip 3^2; the result stays 3
Bit 2 is 1: multiply the result by 3^4 = 81, giving 243
Bit 3 is 1: multiply the result by 3^8 = 6561, giving 1594323
3^13 = 1594323 with 3 squarings and 3 multiplications (the first one by 1), instead of 12 multiplications
